        xd = tile.astype(np.float64)

        # Compute mean manually
        V = xd
        s = np.zeros((V.shape[0], 1), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(V.shape[1]):
            s += V[:, c:c+1]
        s = s / x.shape[1]   # divide by the FULL row length

        # Compute variance (two-pass)
        V = (xd - s) ** 2
        s = np.zeros((V.shape[0], 1), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(V.shape[1]):
            s += V[:, c:c+1]
        s = s / x.shape[1]   # divide by the FULL row length

        # Store mean and variance
        mu = s
        var = s

        # Normalize
        normalized = (xd - mu) / np.sqrt(var + eps)

        # Convert back to original dtype
        result[i:end_row, :] = normalized.astype(x.dtype)

    # Loop over columns
    for j in range(0, cols, tile_cols):
        # Determine end index for current tile
        end_col = min(j + tile_cols, cols)
        tile = x[:, j:end_col]

        # Convert to float64 for computation
        xd = tile.astype(np.float64)

        # Compute mean manually
        V = xd
        s = np.zeros((V.shape[0], 1), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(V.shape[1]):
            s += V[:, c:c+1]
        s = s / x.shape[1]   # divide by the FULL row length

        # Compute variance (two-pass)
        V = (xd - s) ** 2
        s = np.zeros((V.shape[0], 1), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(V.shape[1]):
            s += V[:, c:c+1]
        s = s / x.shape[1]   # divide by the FULL row length

        # Normalize
        normalized = (xd - s) / np.sqrt(s + eps)

        # Convert back to original dtype
        result[:, j:end_col] = normalized.astype(x.dtype)

    return result
